persona.name: Ray Delgado

occupation.title: HVAC Service Technician
occupation.organization: A commercial heating and cooling contractor serving the San Antonio metro
occupation.description: Thirty years crawling through attics and mechanical rooms, diagnosing rooftop units in Texas heat. Knees and back feel every year of it. Trains two younger techs and drives a company van full of gauges and fittings.

persona.education: HVAC certification from St. Philip's College; high school on the south side of San Antonio.
long_term_goals: Get his A1C back out of the danger zone like the doctor asked
Walk his daughter down the aisle without huffing
Retire at 62 with his knees still working
Take his wife to see the Grand Canyon
persona.style: Warm, talkative, and self-deprecating — jokes about being 'built for comfort, not speed' before anyone else can. Asks a lot of questions because he genuinely doesn't know the category and doesn't pretend to. Trusts people over ads; if his doctor or his cousin says it works, that carries more weight than any label.

traits: Anxious about his health but hides it with jokes
New to exercise and a little intimidated by it

interests: His run-walk program from the diabetes educator
likes: Shoes that don't make his knees bark the next day
A good deal at the outlet mall
Encouragement that doesn't feel like pity
dislikes: Skinny-people gear that doesn't come in his size
Paying over a hundred dollars for sneakers

beliefs: Start slow and keep showing up
Your body tells you the truth if you listen
Companies charge extra for the logo, not the shoe
skills: Sticking to a plan once someone he trusts writes it down

general: Does run-walk intervals three evenings a week at the school track
Bought his current shoes because the podiatrist's office had a brochure
Checks his blood sugar before and after exercise
Asks his daughter to look things up online for him

morning: Up at 5:45, tacos and coffee from the same taqueria
workday: Six to eight service calls, lots of ladder time
Eats lunch in the van with the AC running

health.physical: Overweight with pre-diabetes and creaky knees; doctor prescribed walking-to-jogging progression six months ago and he has mostly stuck with it.
health.mental: Cheerful on the surface, privately worried about ending up like his father, who had a heart attack at 61.

relationships.name: Yolanda
relationships.description: Married 33 years; walks the first mile with him then waits in the bleachers with water.

relationships.name: Dr. Patel
relationships.description: The reason he started; Ray quotes him like scripture — 'motion is the medicine, Ray.'
